title: Raghunath Chaudhary Rachanavali (ৰঘুনাথ চৌধাৰী ৰচনাৱলী)
author: Raghunath Chaudhary (Ed. Atulchandra Barua)
description: Collected works of Assam's celebrated 'Bihogi Kobi' (Poet of Birds), Raghunath Chaudhary. His verses celebrate the river valleys, avifauna, flora, and agricultural rhythms of the Brahmaputra and Burhi Dihing basins, closely echoing traditional Tai nature imagery (Nok, Mai, Nam).
source: Guwahati: Publication Board Assam, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451225

sentences.free_translation_en: This volume anthologizes the complete nature and avifaunal poetry of Assam's 'Bihogi Kobi', Raghunath Chaudhary.
